howto.what: claude-mem 把 Claude 每次的 Read、Edit、Bash 操作压成一条压缩 observation，会话结束时做汇总；相关条目会自动注入后续提示，让下一次会话带着上次的上下文开始，不用重新解释代码库或重新摸索已定决策。
howto.when: 在项目的第二次会话起，记忆注入开始生效；首次会话只为新项目播种记忆。当用户问「claude-mem 怎么工作」或「这东西在干什么」时，也会用它来解释。

say.note: 说明观察捕获、注入时机和数据存放位置。

say.text: 这个东西在后台到底在干什么？
say.note: 会得到同样的流程解释。

say.text: 运行 /learn-codebase 把整个仓库预先装进记忆

howto.what_en: claude-mem turns each Read, Edit, and Bash call into a compressed observation; observations are summarized at session end, and relevant ones are auto-injected into later prompts so a new session starts with context from the last one.
howto.when_en: Memory injection begins on your second session in a project; the first session seeds memory for a fresh project. It also explains itself when you ask how claude-mem works.

say_en.note: Explains capture, injection timing, and where data lives.
